item.title: Beaver police are still searching for man suspected of violent crimes
item.description: Late on March 4, 2026 a Beaver neighborhood was asked to either evacuate or shelter in place after a man was seen fleeing into a house.

item.title: Wayne County communities remember, honor 3 women police said were killed by a stranger
item.description: Neighbors placed ribbons around Wayne County on Thursday, from Loa to Torrey, to honor and remembered 3 women who investigators said died at the hands of a stranger.

item.title: Woman says Kouri Richins told her things would ‘be better’ if her husband were dead
item.description: An employee of Eric Richins' company testified Thursday that Kouri Richins once told her that things would be better if her husband were dead.

item.title: Ace Bailey Career High Helps Jazz End Losing Streak Against Washington
item.description: Despite missing four starters, the Utah Jazz were able to end their losing streak with a 122-112 win over the Washington Wizards on Thursday.

item.title: ‘Another stage of life’: Utah couple embraces aging with help from geriatric care
item.description: Geriatric specialists help identify the changes that come with aging and work with patients to maintain their independence, including using screenings and early detection to address potential health problems before they become serious.

item.title: Utah Jazz, Ace Bailey Spoil Trae Young’s Wizards Debut
item.description: The Utah Jazz, led by Ace Bailey, snapped their seven-game losing streak, beating the Washington Wizards 122-112.

item.title: The Hat Trick: Vanecek Stands On His Head As Mammoth Shutout Flyers
item.description: Despite a rocky season with starts few and far between, backup goaltender Vitek Vanecek stood on his head as he led the Utah Mammoth to victory in a shutout over the Flyers.

item.title: Utah Baseball To Open New Era With First Game At America First Ballpark
item.description: Opening day always carries anticipation, this one carries history. It will be the first chapter of Utah baseball’s new home — and the beginning of a new era for the program.

item.title: “A Real Gut Punch”: Lyman Mayor Mourns Relative Among Three Women Killed
item.description: Residents of Lyman, their mayor and surrounding communities in Wayne County are mourning the loss of three women after a series of violent killings that stunned the quiet rural area.
